title: Head-dependent groundwater exchange and one-pass endpoint consistency
purpose: Replace prescribed forecast/actual groundwater exchange with a deterministic linear head-difference surrogate and measure whether a one-pass realized exchange remains consistent with the Ribasim level produced by that same window.

physical_surrogate.sign: positive is Basin infiltration to groundwater; negative is groundwater drainage to Basin
physical_surrogate.interpretation: GHB-like linear head-dependent research surrogate only; not MODFLOW package equivalence

scope: derive forecast Basin exchange from committed Basin level and forecast groundwater head
derive one-pass actual Basin exchange from the same committed Basin level and actual groundwater head
re-evaluate the head-dependent exchange at realized Basin end level without mutating state
report endpoint exchange residual between one-pass exchange and realized-end-level exchange

experiments.H1: sign and zero-crossing: Basin above groundwater gives infiltration, below gives drainage, equal heads give zero exchange
experiments.H2: groundwater-head drop creates the canonical late conflict from physical state rather than prescribed infiltration
experiments.H3: nonzero realized Basin-level change produces a measurable endpoint exchange residual under one-pass coupling
experiments.H4: zero state change gives zero endpoint exchange residual
experiments.H5: one-pass physical exchange at a fixed start state is independent of SWAP management request
experiments.H6: physically excessive head-driven infiltration still fails closed through the qualified Ribasim balance

interpretation_rules: endpoint residual is a consistency diagnostic, not yet an error tolerance or convergence criterion
nonzero endpoint residual motivates a separately preregistered iterative/fixed-point experiment; it does not by itself prove a production iteration requirement
no exchange flux is clipped to preserve management delivery
same-window SWAP demand remains frozen as in DUMMY-02
forbidden: no claim of MODFLOW RIV/GHB package equivalence
no nonlinear or iterative coupling solver in this work unit
no production SWAP, MODFLOW, Ribasim or iMOD Coupler change
external_basis: MODFLOW 6 documentation: head-dependent boundary flow is proportional to head difference through conductance
Ribasim Basin coupling surface: level/storage plus infiltration/drainage variables
